name: cliff-slope-wrap-limits
description: cliff-slope-wrap with Enforce Terrain Limits ticked first (Scenario > Map Preferences in the editor, Map Properties > Preferences in Studio, unsaved there when the click comes): Increase Two from 14 does nothing at all (tools.ts ENFORCED_TOP_LEVEL: nothing above 14 with the switch on)

steps.eval: const wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); await w3.commands.execute('w3.mapInfo.open', 'preferences'); let box = null; for (let i = 0; i < 100 && !box; i++) { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('.map-info .form-body')].find((x) => x.querySelector('h2')?.textContent === 'Preferences'); const l = b && [...b.querySelectorAll('label.form-check')].find((x) => x.textContent.trim() === 'Enforce terrain limits'); box = l?.querySelector('input') ?? null; if (!box) await wait(100); } if (!box) throw new Error('no Enforce terrain limits box'); if (!box.checked) box.click(); await wait(500);
